name: cohors
description: Every git repo you own as one fleet your agent can see, search, plan across, and (opt-in) act on. Fleet status, cross-repo search, per-repo tasks and flows, and a focus board.

git_actions.title: Git actions
git_actions.description: Let Claude fetch, pull, push, commit and stash across your repositories. Pull is fast-forward only, push never forces, and commit and stash still ask Claude to confirm. Start a new session after changing it.

run_commands.title: Run commands
run_commands.description: Let Claude run one shell command in many repositories at once (tests, a codemod). Each run needs a deliberate confirm and is capped by your config's run allowlist. Start a new session after changing it.

launchpad_writes.title: Launchpad writes
launchpad_writes.description: Let Claude write a repo's .cohors/repo.json, your focus board and the activity log. Launchpad files only, never git. Start a new session after changing it.
